industrial.title: Industrial land
industrial.description: Fill color of industrial areas, garages, and dams.

ice.title: Ice
ice.description: Fill color of glaciers and ice shelves.

waterFill.title: Water body
waterFill.description: Fill color of lakes, seas, and reservoirs. Sits apart from the waterway line color.

railway.title: Railway
railway.description: Color of railway lines and their hatching.

aerowayCasing.title: Aeroway casing
aerowayCasing.description: Color of runway and taxiway casings.

aerowayFill.title: Aeroway surface
aerowayFill.description: Color of runways, taxiways, and apron areas.

highwayArea.title: Highway area
highwayArea.description: Fill color of pedestrian areas and other mapped road surfaces.

transitLabel.title: Transit label
transitLabel.description: Text color of transit stop labels.

waterwayLabel.title: Waterway label
waterwayLabel.description: Text color of river, stream, and canal labels.

roadContrast.title: Road contrast
roadContrast.description: Lightness distance between minor road surfaces and the canvas. Bright sets it low, so minor roads read as a slight lift off the land.

casingContrast.title: Casing contrast
casingContrast.description: Lightness distance between a major road fill and its casing.

textContrast.title: Text contrast
textContrast.description: Lightness distance between secondary text and the canvas. Secondary text covers points of interest, road names, and airports.

haloAssist.title: Halo assist
haloAssist.description: Extra halo width in pixels added when a label sits flat against the canvas and its halo carries the whole separation. Scales from zero, where the text clears the canvas by the text contrast target on its own, to this value.

haloLiftAlpha.title: Halo lift alpha
haloLiftAlpha.description: Opacity of a lifting halo, the kind that only holds back clutter around text that already reads against the feature it names. Softer than the opaque halos that carry legibility on their own.

labelSizeWaterway.title: Waterway label size
labelSizeWaterway.description: Text size in pixels for river, stream, and canal labels.

labelSizeWaterBody.title: Water body label size
labelSizeWaterBody.description: Text size in pixels for lake and sea labels at high zoom.

labelSizePoi.title: Point of interest label size
labelSizePoi.description: Text size in pixels for point of interest, transit, and airport labels.

labelSizeRoad.title: Road label size
labelSizeRoad.description: Text size in pixels for road names at high zoom.

labelSizeShield.title: Shield label size
labelSizeShield.description: Text size in pixels for the road number inside a highway shield.

labelSizePlaceOther.title: Other place label size
labelSizePlaceOther.description: Text size in pixels for suburbs, quarters, and other minor places at high zoom.

labelSizeVillage.title: Village label size
labelSizeVillage.description: Text size in pixels for village labels at high zoom.

labelSizeTown.title: Town label size
labelSizeTown.description: Text size in pixels for town labels at high zoom.

labelSizeState.title: State label size
labelSizeState.description: Text size in pixels for state labels at high zoom.

labelSizeCity.title: City label size
labelSizeCity.description: Text size in pixels for city labels at high zoom.

labelSizeCapital.title: Capital label size
labelSizeCapital.description: Text size in pixels for capital city labels at high zoom.

labelSizeCountry.title: Country label size
labelSizeCountry.description: Text size in pixels for country labels at high zoom.

showLand.title: Land
showLand.description: Shows the background, land use areas, and land cover.

showRoads.title: Roads
showRoads.description: Shows roads, paths, piers, and oneway arrows.

showRailways.title: Railways
showRailways.description: Shows railways, rail yards, and cable cars.

showAeroways.title: Aeroways
showAeroways.description: Shows runways, taxiways, and apron areas.

showPois.title: Points of interest
showPois.description: Shows point of interest icons and labels, including transit stops and airports.

showWaterLabels.title: Water labels
showWaterLabels.description: Shows names of water bodies and waterways. Requires water.

showRoadLabels.title: Road labels
showRoadLabels.description: Shows road names and highway shields. Requires roads.

showPlaceLabels.title: Place labels
showPlaceLabels.description: Shows names of countries, states, cities, towns, and villages.
